green_summary.2.2.a_evidence_admission_and_identity_bi: lib/delivery/evidence.js. createLaunchAuthority(secret) is the local trusted launcher (Runner.Dispatch.v1 equivalent): issueDispatch binds runnerId/run/gate/inputDigest/policyDigest/attempt/epoch/role/execution under an HMAC-SHA256 integrity digest; the secret stays in the closure and never appears on any exported surface. admitEvidence consumes the P2_1 EvidenceEnvelope schema via parseContract and enforces, in deterministic order: schema validity with explicit version boundary (B07: legacy 0 / future 2 refused, never field-fabricated); registered source (no authority-issued dispatch => UNREGISTERED_SOURCE, A05); launcher integrity (any field mutation or hand-built record => FORGED_DISPATCH); identity (builder execution cannot sign acceptance => IDENTITY_CONFLICT, A06); envelope pinned to the dispatch (execution/origin/candidateDigest re-declarations refused, so self-declared role labels and env strings grant nothing); currency (stale policy digest, stale candidate input digest, foreign environment string, expired envelope all refused); duplicate issuance (one execution identity signs exactly one envelope, replay refused); real observation data (pass/fail/red with zero valid executions or contradictory counts => NO_OBSERVATION, A18 — while a truthful unverified envelope carrying a real probe artifact is admitted so the gate can block). Refusals return a complete audit record (origin, execution, caseId, envelopeDigest, dispatchExecution). Evidence class ('independent-acceptance' | 'authoring-self-check') is derived from the dispatch role, never from the envelope.
green_summary.2.2.b_pure_gate_evaluation_and_rejection: lib/delivery/gate.js. evaluate(inputs, receipts, policy) is the SDD.Gate.v1 pure judgment: it returns only { verdict, receipt }, the receipt is validated against contracts/delivery GateReceipt v1 before returning (fail-closed internal invariant), and the module imports no fs/child_process channel at all — no dispatch, no current-stage writes, byte-identical receipts for identical inputs (all proven by test). Structural defense re-verifies every admission entry: digest-vs-envelope (TAMPERED_RECEIPT), identity-vs-binding (TAMPERED_RECEIPT), policy rotation (STALE_POLICY), input rotation (STALE_INPUT), and receipt execution == builder execution (IDENTITY_CONFLICT, A06 — admission cannot see this, the gate can). Per required check from the frozen TestContract: exact capability match only (B06: 'service-log' and 'dom' receipts cannot close a required 'console' check), independent-acceptance class only (B03: authoring self-check produces AUTHORING_SELF_CHECK_ONLY and stays visible in sourceAttestation), and result pass with real valid executions (A18: MISSING_OBSERVATION for absent receipts, UNVERIFIED_CAPABILITY with the observed count for unverified/zero-execution receipts). Malformed TestContract/policy/inputs throw INVALID_* — the gate refuses to judge rather than guessing. An empty judged set is represented honestly by EMPTY_EVIDENCE_SET_DIGEST (sha256 of '[]') since the schema requires a non-empty evidence array; sourceAttestation is 'none/none' in that case.
green_summary.2.2.c_protected_source_boundary_local_ha: Expressed with real permission negatives, not file-lock theater: (1) fixtures are structural only — a hand-written envelope shaped like a registered-runner pass is UNREGISTERED_SOURCE and a hand-shaped dispatch is FORGED_DISPATCH; (2) a real spawnSync child process receives the public binding fields with a scrubbed environment (no launcher secret to inherit — children inherit no identity), forges a well-shaped verifier dispatch plus a self-signed pass envelope, and parent-side admission refuses it FORGED_DISPATCH; (3) the authority object exposes only issueDispatch/verifyDispatch and no serialization surface contains the secret (A19 local half: key isolation by construction). The real protected-Runner registration/publication-key isolation is explicitly NOT claimed here — see unverified.

test_fixes_between_red_and_green.finding: five RED-phase test corrections were needed before GREEN; two of them were the new implementation correctly catching bad fixtures
test_fixes_between_red_and_green.details: (1) STALE_CANDIDATE unit test changed only the dispatch digest while the envelope still carried the current digest, so the pinning check (CANDIDATE_BINDING_MISMATCH) fired before the currency check — test now builds envelope and dispatch consistent with each other but both lagging the current input; (2) the two digest-related refusals were asserted against the digest label ('policy/managed-pilot@r0') although a one-way digest can only surface as its hex value — assertions now match the bound hex digest; (3) the case module's V_A05 helper (admitOne) silently issued a launcher dispatch, which would have made the self-signed envelope admissible — the test now calls admitEvidence directly with no dispatch, the actual self-signing situation; (4) the V_B06 fixture pointed node --test at a nonexistent 'log' target, producing a zero-observation run whose pass claim admission correctly refused (NO_OBSERVATION) — the fixture now uses a real passing run and binds it to the service-log check; (5) the V_A18 crash-case expectation hardcoded '0 valid execution' while the real crashed run legitimately shows pass+fail=1 executed test per the P2_1 TAP semantics — the assertion now derives the expected count from the observed envelope instead of a hardcoded number, and the V_A05 audit-capture line was moved next to the direct admission call. None of these weaken an oracle; (3) and (4) are positive evidence that admission rejects fabricated observation data.

blockers_or_questions: GateReceipt v1 requires a non-empty evidence array, so a gate receipt over an empty judged set cannot literally list zero digests; evaluate uses EMPTY_EVIDENCE_SET_DIGEST (sha256 of the canonical '[]') as the honest digest of the empty set and attests origin/execution 'none'. If a later task prefers a nullable evidence field, that is a schema change on top of contracts/delivery (P2_1 owner), not something P2_2 should do unilaterally.

The launch-authority HMAC secret is the local stand-in for the protected Runner's dispatch-signing identity. Real key custody (protected CI/service side only, per architecture) and the second Verifier-instance identity independence across machines remain Runner-side obligations; the module's API is shaped so the Runner can substitute a real signature without changing admission semantics.
